title: Canonical derived section-module tensor data
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and work on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the section-module categories and fixed exact section equivalences $E_X$, ordinary module operations and normalized tensor/unit/total comparisons of [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors]. Localizing $E_X$ termwise gives the equivalence $D(E_X)$, by localization of its inverse, unit and counit. The internal module categories have the unbounded derived operations [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] and K-flat derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Define the ringed derived pullback by exact termwise localization and derived direct image by K-injective resolutions; the existence of K-injective and functorial flat resolutions transfers through the exact section equivalence. Define the section-module derived tensor by conjugating the internal K-flat derived tensor by $D(E_X)$, and its unit by the image of the internal regular unit. Its comparison is uniquely normalized by the equivalence unit. Countable coproducts supply the graded relative tensors and signed direct-sum cochain totals [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor] in both module categories. Tensor commutes with those sums, with the existing triple and quadruple tensor comparison universal properties. Define the signed total tensor functor from this same direct-sum total; its value on each pair equals the object-level total. Define the localization factor map for $E_X$ and the localized ordinary total comparison. These are the actual specified equivalence and tensor constructions, on all unbounded complexes and with independent site object and morphism universes.

source.place: 07A4 pullback and tensor; 07A6 derived adjunction; 06YU derived tensor; sites-modules.tex 03DJ exact extension by zero; sites.tex 00YV section realization.

proof.text: The existing coproduct and tensor-colimit-preservation instances give both graded tensors, both signed cochain totals, both triple comparison properties and quadruple extensionality. These are the generic Mathlib graded-object and total-complex instance constructions, specialized to the internal and section module categories of [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors] and the relative tensor [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor].

Unfold derivedFunctor to the exact section equivalence functor mapped to derived categories, and apply Functor.isEquivalence_mapDerivedCategory. The section module category already has K-injective resolutions by its Grothendieck abelian instance. No resolution or equivalence is chosen from a bare existence assertion.

Use the natural ordinary tensor comparison of [lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison] to identify right tensor by E(M) with E inverse, right tensor by M, and E. Exactness of an equivalence and flatness of M make this composite exact. Symmetry identifies left tensor with right tensor, so E(M) is flat. Conjugate an existing internal functorial flat cover by E inverse and E; its augmentation is the image of the internal augmentation followed by the equivalence counit. Functors that are equivalences preserve epimorphisms, so this is a functorial flat cover on the section module category.

Write E for the derived equivalence and B for the existing internal derived tensor of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Whisker the product of E.unitIso with itself by B followed by E.functor. This gives the required tensor comparison. Its component formula is definitionally the normalization in the statement. Equality of the normalized components implies equality of the natural transformations by function extensionality and of the isomorphisms by Iso.ext.

Unfold the functor-level totalTensor object. The resulting object is definitionally the same CochainComplex.mapBifunctor signed total; reflexivity proves totalTensor_obj. All definitions and their localization maps retain their existing bodies.

proof_origin.place: U6 Lean proof of the existing construction lemmas: Tags 06YN and 06YU for sum-total tensor and flat resolutions; derived.tex Tags 05RU and 070H for localization and K-injective resolutions. The flat-cover transport and normalization proof are written out in Lean.
